verdict.rationale: Colorado SOS is a public web service, and such a service could plausibly offer analytics or cookie opt-out controls, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry, analytics, cookies or usage-tracking opt-out. The email-notification sign-ups are an unrelated opt-in feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
